definitions.explanation: A feeling of satisfaction derived from one's achievements, qualities, or possessions.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{息子|むすこ}を{誇|ほこ}りに{思|おも}っている。
examples.english: He is proud of his son.
examples.notes: 〜を誇りに思う = to be proud of ~

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{文化|ぶんか}は{私|わたし}たちの{誇|ほこ}りだ。
{誇|ほこ}りを{持|も}って{仕事|しごと}をする。
この{町|まち}の{歴史|れきし}は{住民|じゅうみん}の{誇|ほこ}りであり、みんなが{大切|たいせつ}にしている。
examples.english: The history of this town is a source of pride for its residents, and everyone treasures it.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{努力|どりょく}が{実|みの}り、{誇|ほこ}り{高|たか}い{気持|きも}ちで{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}に{臨|のぞ}んだ。
examples.english: Years of hard work bore fruit, and I attended the graduation ceremony with a feeling of great pride.

notes:
USAGE: {誇|ほこ}り is the noun form of the verb {誇|ほこ}る (to be proud of).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{誇|ほこ}りに{思|おも}う (to feel proud of)
・{誇|ほこ}りを{持|も}つ (to have pride)
・〜の{誇|ほこ}り (the pride of ~)
・{誇|ほこ}り{高|たか}い (proud, dignified)

HOMOPHONE: {埃|ほこり} (dust) - same pronunciation but different meaning and kanji

RELATED:
・{誇|ほこ}る (verb: to be proud of, to boast)
